scope: Update one existing source-topology test to follow the Web, API-v1 and paired patient profile port while retaining transactional set-primary and no-delete-all assertions.

triggeringCi.testName: all patient PUT adapters wire one transactional set-primary operation without delete-all
triggeringCi.assertion: app/api/patients/[id]/route.ts must use the shared operation
triggeringCi.staleExpectation: A direct updatePatientOperation call in every adapter.
triggeringCi.relationship: This local fix addresses one of the four failures; the other three concern the audit topology fixture and reviewed Web Auth loader digests.

checksAddedOrRetained: Each of the three adapters must import updatePatientProfile from its exact approved module, await one call and avoid direct operation/upsert bypasses.
The profile service must import and directly return exactly one updatePatientOperation call.
setPrimaryAmbulatory must derive from the own ambulatoryId body property; operation values remain the normalized values.
The mandatory audit callback must be the final operation input property.
The operation must retain an immediate dbServer transaction, one conditional upsert on the same tx/patient/value, immediately followed by the required audit call.
The operation must import the actual membership helper and transaction audit writer, with one call to each.
No delete(patientsToAmbulatories) is allowed in any adapter, the profile port, transaction owner or membership helper.

compactLog: ok 1 - resolvePrimaryAmbulatoryId accepts non-empty strings only
ok 2 - normalizePrimaryAmbulatoryIdInput sets, clears, or ignores the primary column
ok 3 - profile PUT with ambulatoryId preserves multi-membership and updates the primary column
ok 4 - upsert is idempotent for an already associated ambulatory
ok 5 - invalid ambulatoryId neither wipes memberships nor touches the primary column
ok 6 - explicit null clears the primary column but keeps memberships intact
ok 7 - network-scoped upsert inside a transaction leaves other memberships untouched
ok 8 - all patient PUT adapters wire one transactional set-primary operation without delete-all

environment.testExecution: Outside the restrictive sandbox; canonical run-strip-types runner; owned temporary MEDIFLOW_DATA_DIR removed after the run.
environment.database: The existing focused SQLite fixtures use :memory:.

review.decision: The test now follows the concrete new application-port topology while retaining the same transaction owner and expanding the no-delete-all check to the intermediate port and helper.
limits: These are bounded source-topology assertions; the companion AST audit guard and existing runtime transaction tests carry the control-flow and rollback proof.
This changed test belongs to tsconfig.typecheck.json and is outside the compiler benchmark pinned to the earlier670 tree. The benchmark is not attributed to this delta.
